status: curated primary-source definitions for a common-basis refrigerant comparison

metric_definitions.sample_volume_cm3: reported sample volume in Extended Data Figure 6; the three samples are approximately volume matched
metric_definitions.observed_minimum_in_sheet_d_K: minimum sampled temperature in the independently labelled Extended Data Figure 6d time trace
metric_definitions.below_1K_observed_span_min: time between the first and last sampled sheet-d values below 1 K; not a fitted time constant
metric_definitions.heat_absorption_mJ_cm3: source-reported volumetric heat absorption; FAA and CPA values are reported by Xiang et al. from Wolf et al.
metric_definitions.cycle_efficiency_percent: source definition eta = heat absorption during the cold process divided by heat release during magnetization at the environment temperature

common_basis_rows.vacuum_note: source reports good chemical stability in high vacuum
hydrate salt; no vacuum-stability equivalence claimed
hydrate salt; no vacuum-stability equivalence claimed

separate_context_rows.usage: different-mass context only; excluded from the common-volume ranking because no matched volume or sheet-d hold trace is available

scope: Only NBCP, FAA and CPA enter the common-basis table because they have approximately matched volumes and independently labelled time traces.
The workbook sheet-a/b curve labels are excluded because they conflict with the identifiable 94 mK NBCP caption point.
The table establishes the material-screening premise and does not predict an ADR stage, terminal field or device hold time.
The source-reported efficiency is not a full refrigerator coefficient of performance.
